name: submit_permission_change
description: submit_permission_change: Submit a permission change request due to a role change. The effective date must not be in the past and must match the HR-approved date. Returns a case ID.

employee_id.description: The employee whose permissions are being changed (e.g. EMP048271).

permission_template_id.description: The permission template selected by the caller (e.g. PTPL-SWE-01).

effective_date.description: The date the role change takes effect, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must match the HR-approved effective date (e.g. 2026-09-01).
